traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz's account of the family, with the Lucid key and FloraBase, as search results quote them (the pages themselves were not read): flowers regular, usually 4-merous or 5-merous; calyx fleshy or leathery, persistent; petals free, often shorter than the sepals; stamens usually twice the petals; ovary half-inferior (superior to inferior across the family), usually 2-locular. A free hypanthium is present in some and absent in others, so none is stated.
